title: A Comprehensive Survey of Small Language Models in the Era of Large Language Models: Techniques, Enhancements, Applications, Collaboration with LLMs, and Trustworthiness

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature on recommender systems that utilize Small Language Models (SLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) with Chain-of-Thought prompting and step-by-step knowledge distillation to mitigate discrepancies between training data item popularity and real-world relevance.

Surveying and comparing existing trustworthiness evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (such as HELM, TrustLLM, FFT, and ROBBIE) that measure small and large language models on broad fairness, safety, and bias metrics.
